summary: At step 70, a landed ice-troll cold claw reaches the hero-attacker arm of uhitm.c:mhitm_ad_cold(). The JS function currently throws at that arm. Port the whole C function, including its existing monster-attacks-hero branch and monster-attacks-monster branch, and retain the existing damageum() -> mhitm_adtyping() dispatch.

source.branch: magr == &gy.youmonst in mhitm_ad_cold(), for a landed AD_COLD attack against a non-hero defender; magic cancellation is checked before frost messaging, cold resistance/defense, golem effects, and item destruction.
callers: uhitm.c:do_attack() calls hmonas() when Upolyd is true.
uhitm.c:hmonas() selects the ice-troll AT_CLAW/AD_COLD attack and calls damageum() after a landed non-physical attack.
uhitm.c:damageum() calls mhitm_adtyping(&gy.youmonst, mattk, mdef, &mhm); uhitm.c:mhitm_adtyping() dispatches AD_COLD to mhitm_ad_cold().
dependencies: Monnam, mon_nam, canseemon, pline, pline_The, pline_mon

evidence: The v26 baseline evaluation challenges/evaluations/20261007095608-v26.json records synthetic/v26/v26-ice-troll-cold-claw stopping at zero-based step 70 with “unsupported hero move: the hero's own cold attack”; 70 of 91 screens match and 21 remain. The exact queue entry carries the same count and evaluation provenance.

The recipe challenges/cases/v26/v26-ice-troll-cold-claw.recipe.session.json polymorphs the hero into an ice troll and creates a peaceful stone giant. include/monsters.h:2233-2240 defines the ice troll with AT_CLAW/AD_COLD damage of 2d6 as its second attack.

upstream/src/uhitm.c:2626-2681 defines all three mhitm_ad_cold() directions. For magr == &gy.youmonst, C checks magic cancellation first; otherwise it prints the frost message unless Blind, handles cold resistance or artifact defense with shield/golem effects and zeroed damage, then adds destroy_items() damage based on the entry damage. The hero-defender and monster-versus-monster arms are also part of this whole function.

The C route is upstream/src/uhitm.c:do_attack() -> hmonas() -> damageum() -> mhitm_adtyping() -> mhitm_ad_cold(). hmonas() calls damageum() after the landed non-physical polyform blow; damageum() supplies the hero as attacker and the type dispatcher routes AD_COLD.

js/uhitm.js:4225-4264 currently implements only the mhitu arm of mhitm_ad_cold(); its magr === state.youmonst branch calls unsupported("the hero's own cold attack"). js/uhitm.js:6972-7004 already dispatches AD_COLD, and hmonas()/damageum() are already wired, so the missing source unit is the whole mhitm_ad_cold() function rather than an unconnected caller.
